Health and quality of life through technology
​At DTU Health Tech, we aspire to improve good health and quality of life through technology for better prediction, prevention, early diagnosis, and treatment.
We want to educate and inspire the health technology engineers of the future in a dynamic, innovative, and research-based environment.
We aim to drive research and innovation towards the translation of the next generation healthcare solutions in close collaboration with clinicians and basic researchers, and industry for the benefit of people and a sustainable society.

01 October 2026
Fabian Hecker receives the Albert-Overhauser Award
DTU Postdoc Fabian Hecker, DTU Health Tech, has received this year's Albert-Overhauser Award. The German Chemical Society has presented Fabian Hecker with the award for an outstanding scientific publication.
01 October 2026
Associate Professor Bastian Epp receives DTU’s Teaching Development Award 2026
Bastian Epp receives the award for his work in creating an engaging teaching environment that focuses on feedback and active participation in a course with many students from diverse academic backgrounds.
23 September 2026
DTU researchers awarded PREPARE grants from Novo Nordisk Foundation
Novo Nordisk Foundation has once again recognized three ambitious projects aimed at developing innovative teaching and assessment formats that strengthen students’ creative and critical thinking skills.
